answer: Reaching the haven of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, capped per identity per epoch, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Each submission hangs on the anchor of a task receipt, and the trellis is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
